newsitem.title: USA: American Stores to market home HIV test.
newsitem.headline: American Stores to market home HIV test.

text.p: (Home Access Health Corp) said on Monday it signed an agreement allowing American Stores Co to sell its HIV home-test kits.
The Home Access and Home Access Express HIV-1 tests will be available at American Stores' 848 Osco and Sav-on drug stores in 18 states, said Home Access.
The American Stores pact enhances the company's presence in such major markets as Boston, Los Angeles and Chicago, the company said.
American Stores is a retail holding company whose subsidiaries include Osco and Sav-on drug stores, Jewel Food Stores, Lucky Stores, Acme Markets and Super Saver.
